nexaboard-desc: Provides threaded discussion boards on user pages, replacing user talk pages.
nexaboard-welcome-body: This is where you can leave messages, ask questions, and connect with other users. Please be respectful and follow the [[$1|community guidelines]].
nexaboard-guidelines-summary: Creating the Board guidelines page (added automatically by the NexaBoard extension)
nexaboard-guidelines-content:
This page explains how '''boards''' work on $1 and the guidelines for using them. Administrators are encouraged to edit it to match this community's rules.

== What is a board? ==
Every registered user has a personal '''board''' — a threaded discussion space attached to their user page where anyone can leave public messages, ask questions, and start discussions. It replaces the traditional user talk page with a friendlier, conversation-style interface. You can reach a user's board from the '''Board''' tab on their user page, or at [[Special:NexaBoard]].

== Community guidelines ==
* '''Be respectful.''' Treat others the way you would like to be treated. Personal attacks, harassment, and hate speech are not tolerated.
* '''Stay on topic.''' Keep each thread focused on one subject and give it a clear, descriptive title.
* '''No spam or advertising.''' Do not post promotional links or repetitive messages.
* '''Respect privacy.''' Never share other people's personal information.

== Moderation ==
Users with the appropriate rights can '''close''', '''delete''', '''move''', and '''merge''' threads to keep boards tidy. All administrative actions are recorded in the [[Special:Log/nexaboard|board log]].

== About the extension ==
Boards are provided by the '''NexaBoard''' extension, created by [https://nexawiki.com/ NexaWiki]. See [[Special:Version]] for the installed version and license details.
